title: Record the finite q-Toeplitz factorization
body:
## Summary
- The sequences `g_j = q^{j^2}/f_j` and `h_j = (-q)^j/f_j` give `T(g)T(h) = I` and the five-factor inverse of `G_ij = q^{(i-j)^2}`.
- This holds for all 30 matrices with `q` in `{1/4, 1/5, 1/6, 1/8, 1/10}` and order 1 through 6.
- At `q = 1/4` the product bound is `14/15` and the row-sum bound is `10/7`. The selected κ is unchanged.
